name: Fighter Ring Dancer — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Fighter Ring Dancer from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Ring Dancer (Fighter Archetype)" but are not part of the Fighter Ring Dancer entry, which is unchanged.

A ring dancer’s dancing rings can be used to perform any unarmed strike the ring dancer could make with his fists, as well as the bull rush, disarm, drag, reposition, or trip combat maneuvers. When using his dancing rings to bull rush or drag, the ring dancer doesn’t have to move unless failing to do so would put his rings out of range to use the maneuver.

This ability replaces stunning fist.

Deadly Rings (Su)
